# Mechidan

> Your business gets the website, server or tool it is missing, within a week. Free 30-minute diagnostic, in writing. Fixed price before work starts.

Two people: Kamil El Kouarti builds and runs the technical side, his business partner handles the conversation with the client. Based in Madrid, Spain. Serves businesses of 1 to 100 people, remotely in Spain and abroad, in Spanish and English.
Contact: kamil@mechidan.com, phone and WhatsApp +34 611 283 310

## Free diagnostic

- A 30-minute conversation, free of charge.
- The client receives one written page: what the owner would do, in what order, the fixed price of each step, and what the client can do themselves without paying.
- The page ends with one concrete offer and a delivery date. The client decides: do it themselves, hire someone else, or hire Mechidan.

## Services and prices

- **Server review** (€99, VAT included). Before a customer discovers your server is broken, you do.
- **Server move** (€199, VAT included). Your site changes address on a Tuesday at three in the morning and your customers never notice.
- **New website** (€299, VAT included). Someone searches for what you sell, finds you and calls.
- **Website with bookings or orders** (€449, VAT included). Your customer books at eleven at night and you see it in the morning from your phone.
- **A tool built for you** (fixed price quoted after the diagnostic). Tell me the task that eats your morning and I put it on one screen.

## Terms

- Delivery: 1 to 7 days, counted from the moment the client has handed over all the material.
- Prices are fixed, cover the whole job and include VAT. Nothing gets added on top later.
- Every job includes 3 months of care: if something acts up, the client calls and it gets fixed with no invoice. After that, optional care at €29 per month, cancel anytime.
- If the job needs less than the description, the price drops and the scope sheet records it.
- Guarantee: if the client does not like the delivered result, they do not pay and no invoice is issued.
- No deposit and no payment up front.
- Payment happens off the website by bank transfer or Bizum, after the client approves the work.
- The client owns the code, the configuration and the domain from day one. No lock-in.

## Questions and answers

### Is the price really fixed?
Yes. The number on each service includes VAT and the whole job. If your case needs less, I take out what you won't use and the number drops. The final number goes in writing in the scope sheet.

### How long does it take?
One to seven days once I have your material: text, logo and access. A simple site lands in two. A move with mail and certificates runs to five or seven. The exact date goes in the scope sheet.

### How do I pay?
Outside this website, by bank transfer or Bizum, once you approve the work. I issue an invoice with full tax details. This page takes no payments and stores no banking data.

### Is the website really mine?
Yes. The domain registers in your name, the code gets handed to you and the hosting sits in your account. Tomorrow you can take everything without asking me.

### I pay a monthly fee for a tool. Can you get rid of it?
Sometimes. I check whether an equivalent exists that you can host yourself. If it does, I set it up and charge three months of that fee. If it doesn't, I say so and charge nothing. I stay away from invoicing and anything with a legal obligation attached.

### What do you need from me to start?
The text you want to show, your logo if you have one, and access to the domain if you already bought it. If you have none of that, I write a first draft and you correct it.

### Where do you work?
Remotely, with clients in Spain and abroad. In Madrid we come in person when the job needs it: a server that doesn't reach the internet, an office where we need to see the setup.

### I already have a website and I don't want to change it
Then look at the move or the review. I can shift what you have to a cheaper server, or tell you where it sits exposed, without touching the design.

### What do you do with my data?
I keep your name and your contact so I can reply, nothing else. I sell no data, run no advertising and set no tracking. The privacy policy spells it out.
